entries.en: It'll be taken care of... Don't worry, my friend...
entries.ro: O să se rezolve... Nu-ți face griji, prietene...

entries.en: Huh...? Of course I didn't forget, the order has been confirmed and is en route to Japan...
entries.ro: Hm? Sigur că n-am uitat, comanda a fost confirmată și e pe drum spre Japonia...

entries.en: I'm getting the fuck outta here!

entries.ro: Te rog, sunt o persoană bună!

entries.en: You're really getting up my ass.
Why would I lie to you? You're my best client... Two days, maximum. We'll be in touch.
entries.ro: De ce ți-aș minți? Ești cel mai bun client al meu... Două zile, maxim. Ne auzim.

entries.en: Exactly like you wanted... Relax, OK? We'll talk later.
entries.ro: Exact cum ai vrut... Relaxează-te, OK? Vorbim mai târziu.
